branches.feedback: The architecture bottleneck has shifted from missing concepts to integration identity. Prioritize a shared semantic_epoch/basis/version/trace contract across executable H1 slices and measure integration defects before adding organs.

ActiveAssembly packet identity now fails closed on same-ID divergent payloads. Preserve exact-duplicate idempotency. Keep exposed packet fingerprints non-normative across H1/H2 until canonicalization is frozen.
Add a held-out cross-language canonicalization fixture for FRANK semantic identities. Do not assume Python JSON hashes are ClayCode-canonical. BASE package promotion remains receipt-gated.

Next highest-information H1 test is an integrated Golden Trace linking StateLedger, ActiveAssembly, WorkspaceEpisode, loop decision, effect/outcome and re-entry with shared identity and crash/intervention controls.
WorkspaceEpisode now makes receiver stages executable. Compare GWT admission against EVENT_BUS and preserve delivery/reconstruction/uptake/causal-use separation.
Do not treat recurrence, broadcast or integrated replay as emergence. Use the new causal stage receipts only as intervention instrumentation for later lesion/rescue and re-entry tests.
Same-ancestry opposite visibility is a concrete set-valued/conflict case. Preserve it in bounded assembly without creating a separate persistent hyperposition service.
Represent packet identity, ancestry, conflict visibility and causal receiver stages as derived diagnostic edges; never convert conflict visibility into independent evidence credit.

Canonical semantic identity must bind replay across assembly/GWT/effect lineage. Physical SQLite layout remains open; WAL writer/checkpoint behavior must be benchmarked on target Ubuntu rather than inferred from logical unity.
